data.hypothesis: A two-shuffle XOR butterfly over the four shared warp totals may reduce cross-warp combine work relative to the prior five-step warp reduction or serial lane-0 sum. This changes only the block-local combine while retaining 128-element tiles, recursive host stages, and modulo-2^32 partials; the full-program measurements do not establish that local reduction is the bottleneck.

memory_lessons.applicability: The supplied repeated timings are for the complete program with the recursive stages retained.
memory_lessons.claim: Three distinct valid warp-first candidates had reported means of about 29.55–30.29 µs versus the 46.24 µs baseline, but those measurements do not isolate the local reduction as the cause.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Compare another isolated block-local combine while holding the tile and host-stage structure fixed; rely on controller measurements for any conclusion.

data.notes: The catalog reports 3 valid, distinct programs and no repeated programs. Historical full-program results: baseline-e1 mean 46.2441 µs (46.5651, 46.0806, 46.0864); 908efebec59a4521 mean 30.2946 µs (30.7674, 30.0762, 30.0403); f5b882300c2342ad mean 29.5740 µs (29.8016, 29.6538, 29.2666); 5d7bc2e7147748c2 mean 29.5522 µs (29.8163, 29.6307, 29.2096). The prior displayed correctness logs report 10 passing cases each, with guards intact and inputs unchanged; they do not show n=0. Development attempt 908efebec59a4521-h01 failed to build with a generic build-failed diagnostic. This candidate has no correctness result or timing yet; those are for the controller to establish. Scratch bank offsets, ABI, default-stream ordering, and the recursive staging are retained.
transformations: Replaced the modulo/shared-memory reduction tree with five warp-local shuffle-down additions, one shared unsigned total per warp, and a two-stage XOR butterfly across the four totals in warp zero.

Used unsigned modulo-2^32 addition for all partial sums and mapped each residue to an in-range signed int before storing it, so recursive stages recover the same residue without out-of-range signed conversion.
Kept 128-thread blocks, zero-filled tail handling, the existing alternating scratch-bank offsets, recursive host launches, ABI, and default-stream ordering; writes zero asynchronously for n <= 0.
